title: Craft
body:
Syntax: craft weapon <type> <unique name>
        craft armor <slot> <unique name>

Crafting asks which metal to use. Respond with iron, steel or chakra steel, consuming two matching ingots, without wood. Optional gem inlay at creation: respond "iron with ruby" (or "steel with sapphire"). Use a Cut Gem in your inventory, and meet its Gemcutter level requirement. The gem is consumed only when forging succeeds. No gem is required.

The created weapon or armor has one permanent inlay slot. Only one Cut Gem fits; it is recorded in the item prototype and never appended to the visible name. Already forged equipment can be upgraded with 'inlay <item> with <cut gem>' while holding a Copper Chisel. Forged-item names must be unique to avoid upgrading multiple items by accident.

All five top elemental gems grant +10 Hitroll and +10 Damroll to either weapon or armor, plus +15% damage for their corresponding elemental jutsu and 15% resistance to the element that counters them. Ruby/Fire resists Water; Sapphire/Water resists Earth; Emerald/Earth resists Lightning; Amethyst/Wind resists Fire; Topaz/Lightning resists Wind. Percentage effects from multiple pieces stack to 30% max.

Bukijutsu can forge higher metals; other classes are limited to Iron when crafting is unlocked. Existing armor and weapon bonuses remain additive. See help inlay and help gemcut.

Date: 2026-11-02

Anti-alt forging: Newly forged unique-name weapons and armor have a hidden creator-character and trusted TCP peer IP record. Item names and EXAMINE do not reveal it. Another character connecting from the same IP cannot GET or GET ALL that item, receive it via GIVE or TRADE, buy it from a player shop, or win it by auction. This rule follows the original item through other owners. A creator may retrieve their own item. Shared households using one IP are also subject to the restriction; standard-name mass-produced tools are not separately stamped because current inventory stores those items only as name strings. Unstamped items crafted on older versions remain legacy.
